chunks: When they see a sign, they laugh at it,

key_terms.يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ: they laugh at it / they mock it

ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers do when they see a divine sign?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific behavior of the Quraysh who, despite witnessing the Prophet's miracles, dismissed them as mere magic or sorcery to preserve their pride. It underscores the concept of *istikhbar* (mockery) as a symptom of *kibr* (arrogance), illustrating how disbelievers actively distort divine signs rather than merely ignoring them.
